english.note: Use this formal geographic name when you need to specify the Indian subcontinent itself rather than South Asia generally.

examples.english: This book gives a detailed introduction to the geography and history of the Indian subcontinent.
examples.traditional: 呢本書詳細介紹印度次大陸嘅地理同歷史。
